annotation.title_clean: Request for Comments on a Draft Memorandum to the Heads of Executive Departments and Agencies, "Guidance for Regulation of Artificial Intelligence Applications"
annotation.title_en: Request for Comments on a Draft Memorandum to the Heads of Executive Departments and Agencies, "Guidance for Regulation of Artificial Intelligence Applications"
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Office of Management and Budget, Executive Office of the President (Federal Register notice)
annotation.summary_en: Federal Register notice in which OMB requests comments, by March 13, 2020, on a draft memorandum guiding federal agencies on regulatory and non-regulatory approaches to AI, per Executive Order 13859. It aims to reduce barriers to AI adoption while promoting security, privacy, civil liberties and American values. The page also contains unrelated notices.
key_provisions_or_claims: OMB seeks public comments on draft memo guiding agency regulation of AI applications, due March 13, 2020.
Issued under Executive Order 13859 (Feb 11, 2019) on maintaining American leadership in AI.
Agencies should reduce barriers to AI development and adoption.
Agencies should promote security, privacy, civil liberties, freedom, human rights, rule of law and intellectual property respect.
Page also includes unrelated NSF, NRC and DOJ notices.
